title: Screen Glow
description: The Blender short Charge plays on a small screen above a column of type, and the page has no light of its own: every letter is lit by the film, warm on the fire shots and blue at night. Drag the timeline and the light jumps with every cut.
intent: Type as a lit material: the frame is split into 8 by 3 patches that act as small area lights on the floor in front of the screen, with the cinema's fast attack and slow release, so cuts flash across the paragraph and linger.

sources.name: Codrops, Cinema Seat Preview
sources.what: Ported (MIT): the two-step downsample of each frame to 64x27 then 8x3, the per-patch area-light sum receive x emit / (pi d^2 + A), the linear-light sampling, and the 40/14 attack and release; moved from TSL to a precomputed 2D light field multiplied over the page.

sources.name: Charge (2022), Blender Foundation
sources.what: The film, CC BY 4.0, in the 55-second cut from the Codrops demo, re-encoded smaller with short keyframe intervals for scrubbing. Credited on the page.
